evidence: apps/hr-service/src/hr/hr.resolver.ts:88-93 (any viewer holding that role sees full contact PII of any employee)
apps/hr-service/src/hr/hr.resolver.ts:150-154 (employees leaves the whole tenant list unmasked for such a viewer)
apps/hr-service/src/attendance/attendance.resolver.ts:306-309 (a global manager receives the tenant's attendance; moduleCode is optional)
payload.rule_violated: The PKG-02 decision rule (the global role never grants module access) and D5 (a module manager sees only their slice).
payload.notes: Program module-boundaries, package PKG-07, release R4.
